description: Team board: brief each session on the member's tasks and messages, and announce new messages and assignments on later prompts. Silent in repositories without a board.

hooks.command: for p in py python3 python; do command -v $p >/dev/null 2>&1 || continue; $p "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/team.py" hook session-start; rc=$?; case $rc in 3|49) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; done; exit 0
for p in py python3 python; do command -v $p >/dev/null 2>&1 || continue; $p "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/team.py" hook prompt; rc=$?; case $rc in 3|49) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; done; exit 0
